title: Pekulo user data export
description: GDPR portability export (FR-49). One file per user, produced by GET /v1/export. Every top-level node carries its own schema_version so a node can evolve independently of the document.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at which the export started streaming.

identity.description: Identity held by Supabase Auth rather than Postgres. The password hash is never exported.

^(?!schema_version$|generated_at$|identi.description: One node per user-scoped table. `rows` holds every row the exporting user owns.
